Context: 11. Payment of Pension

Pension Payment Order.The Accounts Officer responsible for issuing Pension Payment Order will issue authority, i.e., Pension Payment Order to the pension disbursing authority from whom the pension/ family pension is desired to be drawn monthly. He will also send an intimation to the pensioner along with a certified copy of 'Pension Calculation Sheet' duly countersigned.
